verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Anytype publishing its own MCP server and an agents skill, so external AI assistants can act on Anytype data. That is the server role. Nothing shows Anytype itself connecting to or consuming external MCP servers' tools, which is what this client-side story asks for. Because a knowledge-base app could plausibly ship built-in AI that uses MCP tools, the axis applies, and the lack of evidence means none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
